intent: Restart the 3DS recovery flow on payment pay_056 / basket basket_256, gating the privileged mutation on runtime identity and payment policy.
success_criteria: Real caller identity resolved via /bin/id before any mutation
Security gate evaluated against /docs/security.md and the 3DS/payments policy doc
Payment pay_056 record inspected for customer_id, payment_status, three_ds_status, three_ds_attempts, three_ds_max_attempts
3DS recovery restarted via /bin/payments ONLY if identity is authorized and the payment is 3DS-eligible (attempts < max, recoverable status, caller owns/is permitted on the record)
Answer references each applied policy doc plus the inspected payment record path

args: SELECT p.payment_id, p.record_path, p.basket_id, p.customer_id, p.store_id, p.payment_status, p.three_ds_status, p.three_ds_failure_reason, p.three_ds_attempts, p.three_ds_max_attempts, b.record_path AS basket_record_path, b.basket_status, b.customer_id AS basket_customer_id FROM payment_transactions p LEFT JOIN shopping_baskets b ON b.basket_id = p.basket_id WHERE p.payment_id = 'pay_056' AND p.basket_id = 'basket_256';

agents_md_constraints.rule: When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
use payments tool to manage payment workflow state and supported refund approval/finalization
When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

answer_template.message: Resolved caller via /bin/id ({identity}). Checked 3DS policy + security against payment {payment_record.payment_id} (status={payment_record.payment_status}, 3ds={payment_record.three_ds_status}, attempts {payment_record.three_ds_attempts}/{payment_record.three_ds_max_attempts}). {decision}
